scope: Analytical operation counts and diagnostic scope envelope only; not measured U latency, not a prediction or proof of speedup

exact_shape_operation_counts.direct_conv_count_warning: The production path is FFT, so direct-convolution MAC removal is not a runtime reduction estimate.
exact_shape_operation_counts.not_quadratic_width_scaling: Each convolution has only one axis reduced, 192x192 to192x144 or144x192. Saving is25%, not43.75%.
exact_shape_operation_counts.unchanged_components: Outer residual and some FFT/packing/finishing work remain at192. Two of four forward FFT inputs and two of four inverse FFT outputs shrink25%; not all execution work shrinks25%.

diagnostic_envelope.equal_cost_assumption: The diagnostic groups four identical-shape d1 modules and does not identify each separately. The selected pairs contain three of those four d1 convolutions plus d5. Assuming equal d1 cost gives the proxy, not a measured selected-pair latency.
diagnostic_envelope.upper_envelope_warning: Even deleting the entire selected diagnostic work would be below about.354s in this profile, below the roughly.7s sub1 gap. This is a profiler CPU-scope envelope, not a wall-time bound. Shape/cache/backend effects can invalidate linear scaling.
diagnostic_envelope.no_sum_with_R_or_P: Do not add R/P/prefill median differences from separate runs to this analytical estimate.

one_next_hypothesis.name: Profile-budgeted internal-pair distillation across FFT stages, with immutable outer widths and unchanged approved L AR
one_next_hypothesis.why: Two small25% pair reductions have too little scope to close the target. Allocate one bounded student around enough measured decoder work instead of continuing isolated kernel variants or deleting arbitrary layers.
one_next_hypothesis.candidate_scope: Use real approved-decoder activations to rank internal pair ranks in C192 K7/K11, C96 K11 and C384 K7/K11. Keep outer stage widths, upsamplers, branch count, residual interfaces and AR unchanged. Native-output ranks must respect12 alignment.
one_next_hypothesis.gate_before_training: After U listening, select one rank budget whose conservative analytical cost covers a substantial fraction of the.7s gap while meeting an activation/heldout-output error budget. If no such rank budget exists, report that constraint rather than training more tiny students.
one_next_hypothesis.distillation_and_acceptance: One bounded recovery to immutable decoder teacher, groupwise heldout checks, full voice listening approval, then one independent actual N1 L/candidate comparison. Lower rank is not adopted from MAC counts or mel loss alone.
one_next_hypothesis.risks: Broad internal bottlenecks can still damage voice quality; rejected global width N/O and AR S show the risk. This is a hypothesis, not a claim of feasible quality or sub1 speed.
